trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum is yours. There is no shortcut: one playthrough, no mission replay, no New Game+, so the roadmap's 8 stops are the route — finish the story, clear the strands, then grind the counters in free roam.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end. It is the first story mission and cannot be missed — just follow the story until the chapter card lands.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Before the chapter closes, meditate at the early spot — it is the game's one true missable, and it disappears for good once Chapter 1 ends.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Most of the map's trophies only open up once Jason and Lucia can both be played, which happens here, so free-roam counters start counting in earnest from this chapter on.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. Heist trophies start opening in this chapter, and one Strangers & Freaks strand — the race against Yago — closes mid-story, so start stranger strands the moment they appear instead of stockpiling them.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. Heist trophies continue to open here; keep a manual save at the start of the chapter, because there is no mission replay if you want a second run at anything.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. Make a manual save right before it — it is the last natural stopping point, and after the credits the whole map stays open for cleanup.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Play the story mission Breakfast Run through to its end. Named story missions unlock in order, so keep pushing the main story and this one lands on its own.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Play the story mission The Cartel Heist through to its end. Heist missions open from Chapter 3 onward; there is no way to replay a missed heist, so let the story carry you through each one.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Play the story mission Child's Play through to its end. It is a required story beat — finish the mission and the trophy follows.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Play the story mission Headliners through to its end. Like the other named missions, it is a fixed point on the story route, not something to hunt for.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Play the story mission VCIA Takedown through to its end. It takes place around the airport, so it also puts you in the right part of the map for the airport-themed trophies nearby.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Play the story mission Operation Savage Glory through to its end. It is one of the late story missions, so it arrives naturally if you keep the main story moving.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, visible after the story). The bar is forgiving — about 60% true completion is enough — but Robberies, Underwater Discoveries, Shooting Ranges, Drone Races and Bret's Quests must all be fully done, and optional missions that feed the checklist close mid-story, so do optional content when it appears.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts — jumps, air time and clean landings anywhere in Leonida. Find one jump with a safe landing and repeat it in free roam after the story; the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 if you are chasing A Long Road too.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types at least once — the ranges, races, arcade, bowling, fishing and the rest. You do not need to win or master any of them; one attempt at each type is enough, and most unlock as you explore the map.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Practice each weapon class until the gold time or score is comfortable, then clear them one by one — ranges stay open in free roam, so there is no rush and no missable window.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn each course's corners before racing for the win, and clear them as you travel — the 100% checklist also requires every drone race, so this feeds A Long Road directly.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida — each race type and route counts once. Vary the events instead of repeating one favourite; the tracker counts distinct wins, so a new route is worth more than a repeat.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges appear through the side-story contacts, so follow the fishing thread when it shows up and take the challenge as soon as it is offered.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one full arcade game at an arcade cabinet. Pick any game, play it through to its end screen — one completion is all it takes, and arcades are open from early in the game.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's strand through to his final mission. Contact strands open as you meet people across the story — follow each contact's missions when they appear and the finale unlocks at the end of the chain.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's strand through to his final mission. Work through his missions in order as they appear; like the other contacts, his finale only opens once the earlier jobs are done.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand through to his final mission. Keep his jobs moving alongside the story — contacts' missions stay available after the credits, so there is no deadline, just the chain to complete.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Start every strand the moment it appears — the strand tied to the race against Yago closes in Chapter 3, so do not stockpile stranger missions for later. The other strands stay open after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's strand through to his final mission. Follow his jobs as they come up; the finale caps the chain, and the whole strand is doable in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand through to his final mission. Play his missions in order and the finale opens at the end of the chain — no special requirement beyond finishing the strand.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida's 10 locations. The early Chapter 1 spot disappears permanently once Chapter 1 closes — there is no mission replay and no New Game+ — so meditate at every spot the moment you see one, and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter. The sources disagree on the count (18 vs 15) and on the Chapter 1 spot; both versions are shown below.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunts are a strand of their own — follow his jobs, track the animal he names, and take the shot when it presents itself. His quests must all be finished for the 100% checklist, so do not leave him for last.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — pick up every set you pass and check your collection often, because a finished set only counts once all of its cards are in hand.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK at 100 locations across Leonida. Treat it as a travel checklist: WAiNK everywhere you go, and the count climbs as you cross the map for other trophies.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the small feats scattered through the game — stunts, driving, combat and more — and they tick over naturally while you chase the other trophies. The 100% checklist wants 70, so keep going past 50 if you are chasing A Long Road.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it. Use the map's back roads and water to break line of sight, and keep moving until the stars clear — escaping together is the point, so do not split up mid-chase.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level between them. Plan a short route between three nearby shops, hit them fast, and keep the heat on the whole run — if the stars clear, the chain breaks.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning vehicles as you meet them counts toward both this trophy and the 100% checklist, which wants 200 of 277 — scan everything, early and often, instead of leaving it for cleanup.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Pick a fight with a group close together, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before it ends — a crowded spot with cover nearby makes the fifth takedown far easier.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport. Get to the airfield, find a plane, and take off without a flight plan — the airport is open ground in free roam, so try it whenever you are passing through.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get behind the wheel of a Rhino tank and stir up trouble. Tanks appear where the military keeps them — take one, drive it out, and the trophy is yours once you are rolling in it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, watch the sightlines, take what you came for and leave before anyone raises the alarm — a silent run is the whole requirement, so patience beats speed here.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Plan each vault, get in and out clean, and repeat until the fifth escape — vaults are among the robberies the 100% checklist requires in full, so they feed A Long Road too.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Trucks run set routes through the city — intercept one, crack it open, grab the cash and break away before the response arrives.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Cross every region on the map and the trophy pops once the last area is visited — pair it with WAiNK stops and card hunting so one trip covers three checklists at once.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs its own operation somewhere in Leonida — find one per gang, hit it, and move on to the next. The count is per gang, so a repeat hit on the same gang does not advance it.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Trigger not yet confirmed in public guides. What is known: the name points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, early in the game. Do it as early as you can — its name suggests a first-chapter moment — and check the cited guides for the latest word. Nothing here is invented; the trigger is still open.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Trigger not yet confirmed in public guides. What is known: the description points to smashing out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. No public guide pins the exact showroom or the exact move yet — check the cited guides for the latest word rather than guessing.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl a game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through. One full game at that alley is the ask — it is a light moment between the heavier grinds, and the alley is open in free roam.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: This one is tied to your partnership's profile — the shared moments and partner activities that build your standing as a duo. Keep playing alongside your partner through story and free roam, and watch the cited guides for the exact trigger as it gets pinned down.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make 500 choices. Choices accumulate across the game — dialogue, story decisions and the small calls in between — so this is a pure long-haul counter that climbs while you play everything else. Keep the stepper here to watch it grow.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Trigger not yet confirmed in public guides. What is known: the description hints at a second attempt succeeding where the first did not. No public guide pins the exact moment yet — check the cited guides for the latest word. Nothing here is invented; the trigger is still open.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Trigger not yet confirmed in public guides. What is known: the description suggests a surprising or strange event. No public guide pins the exact trigger yet — check the cited guides for the latest word rather than guessing.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Trigger not yet confirmed in public guides. What is known: the description points to a melee drive-by that bowls people over. No public guide pins the exact setup yet — check the cited guides for the latest word. Nothing here is invented; the trigger is still open.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and jobs — feed them through your contacts steadily instead of sitting on them, and the total climbs as you work the crime stops of the route.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, cars and upgrades all count — buy what you need for the other trophies and the total takes care of itself by the end of the route.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages open up as you earn and explore — buy each one as soon as you can afford it, and the trophy pops with the eighth deed. Keep some cash in reserve for the last ones.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles you want to keep, register them through the app, and repeat until ten are on the books — it pairs naturally with discovering 100 vehicles for Whip It Good.
trophies.name: On the Spot
